recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-7534 unless a future site-wide navigation/tooling decision intentionally reintroduces local page TOCs.
issue_request: FHIR-7534 was a Published/Persuasive non-substantive FHIR-core search-page technical correction from the 2015 May ballot cycle. It asked to remove the page table of contents from the _filter/search_filter page, with final resolution text "remove it".
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn history by commit 5c878e48bca4fa283a20949ed1955e8dbf90273c, whose subject is "#7534 - remove spurious page toc". That commit deleted the only `[%onthispage ...%]` page-TOC macro from `source/search_filter.html`. The Jira comment also records the implementation as an SVN revision.
additional_context: The current `_filter Parameter` page remains in the active navigation hierarchy under RESTful API, so `source/search_filter.html` is still a current build source. Current source contains the page title, section headings, and footer, but no active `onthispage` or page-level TOC macro. Repository-wide source search found no active `[%onthispage` macro, and targeted Zulip/Confluence searches found no later community decision that would require restoring a local page TOC.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the requested page-TOC removal was already applied and preserved.
